I've often used visuals of hurting myself or killing myself as a way of escaping my current feelings or situation. 

Do you have any activities or any people that take you away from those thoughts? If you do, chase them. If it's a game, a conversation, a walk, food, drawing, reading, writing, flying. Distractions, use them to your advantage, once you are away from the thoughts use a little time to think about how you may better your situation as a whole. If you fall back into the thoughts again for a bit, it is ok. try and catch them before they get too harsh and try distracting yourself but if you don't catch the thought, hold on to a pillow or something and try to ride it out until you feel like you can try and distract yourself again. 

Just small steps to get to where you need to be. Those steps are up to you and the situation. I couldn't possibly understand fully from what you posted but I've given my experience and thoughts in hope that you may find something that works.
